```yaml
name: CDK Source Connector Compatibility Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r airbyte-cdk/requirements.txt

      - name: Get certified source connectors
        run: |
          chmod +x tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh
          tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh sources

      - name: Run source connector compatibility tests
        run: |
          find airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-* -type d -name tests -exec pytest {} +
```
